scope.q09: excluded from positive Recall; paraphrase of Q01
scope.q10: excluded from positive Recall; no positive evidence

calculation_q07.formula: margin = operating_income / revenue * 100; delta_pp = fy2025_margin - fy2024_margin
calculation_q07.precision_note: Canonical display rounds the raw-won delta half-up to 2dp (6.64). Subtracting the source-rounded margins 18.82 and 12.17 yields 6.65. This test checks only the raw-won operand path.

metrics.population: one filing, fixed 10-question regression set, not company-wide performance
metrics.answer_complete_definition: Numerator counts supported questions whose required source spans are fully covered. Denominator is only answer_complete_ceiling=true. Partial questions cannot reach a complete answer, so they are outside this denominator.
metrics.source_ceiling_definition: Required source spans are covered. For a partial question this is the document ceiling of the supported claims. It is not a complete answer and it does not measure abstention, because there is no generation layer.

metric_semantics.claim_set_recall: Legacy AND of question.claim_ids whose claim.required is true. Alternative evidence paths are not in this denominator. On a single-path dataset this matches answer_evidence_path_recall.
metric_semantics.question_evidence_satisfied: Legacy question-level AND of those required claims. Not the OR of evidence paths.
metric_semantics.answer_evidence_path_recall: Each positive question contributes exactly one selected evidence path. The first fully covered path wins; otherwise the path with the highest claim-set coverage wins, and declared order breaks ties. The denominator is the sum of selected-path claim counts, so it can change with k and is not comparable to the legacy claim denominator.
metric_semantics.question_answer_evidence_satisfied: A positive question succeeds when at least one evidence path is fully covered. Paths are OR, not AND. Denominator is the positive question count. This is answer-valid evidence, not topical relevance.
metric_semantics.relevant_conflict_hit: Diagnostic only. Numerator is questions whose labeled relevant_conflicting element appears at rank <= k. Denominator is questions that carry that label. A hit is not retrieval success and a miss is not retrieval failure.
metric_semantics.deterministic_calculation: Q07 calculation_q07 is a separate test. It uses the derived operand path and is not added into retrieval recall.

failure_taxonomy_at_5.unit: missed required spans of positive questions

relevant_conflicting_evidence_in_top5.note: Topical conflicting evidence inside the top 5. Not a missed-span cause and not a quality score.

comparison_to_bm25.population: one filing regression set; not a generalization result
comparison_to_bm25.positive_rank_definition: first chunk that covers any answer-evidence span, including a partial path
